post.summary:
Sets the signed-in user's own password: the current one is required,
the new one must be at least 15 characters and differ from it. Clears
`password_must_change`, signs out the user's other sessions, and is
audited. Works while the flag is set; browser sessions only.

204.description: Password set; the user's other sessions are signed out

400.description: Wrong current password, or a new password that is too short or unchanged

409.description: The password was just changed in another session; nothing changed

429.description: Too many wrong passwords for this account (shared with sign-in)

updated_by.description: Local user id that last changed the policy.

accepted_until.description: Required only for accepted risk; RFC 3339 timestamp.

oneOf.description: Who; absent for the platform itself.

body.description:
The note's text; for `resolved` the resolution note; for
`item_outcome` the outcome note.

detail.description:
Structured facts: `from`/`to` for `status`, `assigned` (usernames)
and `severity`; `item_id`, `item_kind`, `item_ref` and
`item_agent_id` for item entries; `resolution` and `accepted_until`
for `resolved`; `reason` for `reopened`.

CaseItemRef.description: An item to add: what it is and its id.

ref.description:
The object's id as the console's panels write it (see
`CaseItemView.ref`).

CaseItemView.description: One item of a case that the viewer can see.

active.description: True while the case is not closed.

agent_id.description: The host that decides who sees the item; absent for software.

evidence_gone.description:
True when the evidence is gone, so that `resolved` is accepted: the
finding is no longer reported, the vulnerability no longer matches
the host, the alarm is closed as mitigated or no longer exists.
Always false for hosts and software.

ref.description:
The object's id as the console's panels write it: the alarm id;
`agent/rule_set/rule` for a finding; `agent/advisory` for a
vulnerability on a host; the agent id for a host; `manager/name`
for software.

severity.description:
Its own severity as its page states it (alarm and finding:
`critical` to `info`; vulnerability: the advisory's), when it has one.

title.description: What to show for it, when it still exists.

CasePage.description: A page of cases, newest change first.

items.description: The cases the viewer can see.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

CaseSummaryView.description: One case as listed. Counts include only items the viewer can see.

accepted_until.description: When accepted risk runs out and the case reopens (RFC 3339).

pending_item_count.description: Visible alarms, findings and vulnerabilities that have no outcome.

version.description: Version for `If-Match` (also the ETag of the detail).
